standard.summary: 训练到指定步数（ac_te_freeze_step）后自动冻结文本编码器，减少后续显存占用和计算量。
standard.effect: 冻结 TE 后 TE 参数不再更新，节省约 10-20% 的 backward 开销（取决于 TE 参与度）。
standard.whenToUse: 训练文本编码器且步数较长时开启。常见做法：前半段训练 TE，后半段冻结 TE 让 UNet/DiT 继续精调。
standard.avoidWhen: 从不训练文本编码器（train_text_encoder=false）时此选项无意义。

standard_en.summary: Freezes the text encoder automatically once training reaches ac_te_freeze_step, cutting VRAM and compute for the rest of the run.
standard_en.effect: After the freeze the TE parameters stop updating, saving roughly 10-20% of the backward cost depending on how much the TE contributes.
standard_en.whenToUse: When you train the text encoder and the run is long. A common recipe: train the TE in the first half, freeze it in the second and let the UNet/DiT keep refining.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Meaningless when the text encoder is never trained (train_text_encoder=false).

advanced.principle: 到达 ac_te_freeze_step 时，对 text_encoder 的所有参数调用 requires_grad_(False)，从优化器 param_groups 中移除 TE 参数。
advanced.tradeoffs: 冻结时机（te_freeze_step）需要根据训练步数比例调整，过早冻结可能限制风格学习，过晚则失去节省的意义。

advanced_en.principle: At ac_te_freeze_step, calls requires_grad_(False) on all text_encoder parameters and removes the TE parameters from the optimizer's param_groups.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: The freeze timing (te_freeze_step) must be tuned to the training-step proportion: freezing too early can constrain style learning, too late loses the point of the savings.
